Exercise 7

# glimpse(starwars)
starwars %>% 
  filter(eye_color=="blue") %>%
  group_by(hair_color) %>%
  summarize(mean_mass = mean(mass, na.rm = TRUE))
## # A tibble: 8 × 2
##   hair_color   mean_mass
##   <chr>            <dbl>
## 1 auburn           NaN  
## 2 auburn, grey     NaN  
## 3 black             53.1
## 4 blond             80.5
## 5 brown            104. 
## 6 brown, grey      120  
## 7 none              64.5
## 8 white            NaN

Exercise 10

library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)

penguins %>% 
  filter(island == 'Dream') %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm) %>% 
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bill = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_depth=mean(bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 
    n=n()
  )
## # A tibble: 2 × 4
##   species   mean_bill mean_depth     n
##   <fct>         <dbl>      <dbl> <int>
## 1 Adelie         38.5       18.3    56
## 2 Chinstrap      48.8       18.4    68

Exercise 14

table4a
## # A tibble: 3 × 3
##   country     `1999` `2000`
##   <chr>        <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 Afghanistan    745   2666
## 2 Brazil       37737  80488
## 3 China       212258 213766
table4a %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -country,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "cases"
  )
## # A tibble: 6 × 3
##   country     year   cases
##   <chr>       <chr>  <dbl>
## 1 Afghanistan 1999     745
## 2 Afghanistan 2000    2666
## 3 Brazil      1999   37737
## 4 Brazil      2000   80488
## 5 China       1999  212258
## 6 China       2000  213766


Exercise 15

ggplot(
  msleep %>% 
         filter((conservation == "domesticated" | conservation == "lc") & (vore == "carni" | vore == "herbi")
                ), 
  mapping = aes(x = sleep_total, fill = vore)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) + 
  facet_grid(vore ~ conservation)
